state:
**Goal `path-literals-follow-up`: Stage 3 is under way.** Stages 1 and 2 are on disk, and Stage 1's floor is goal `plain-comments`'s list.

ADR 0245 is on disk (`docs/decisions/0245.md`). It modifies `rule:config/a-relative-path-resolves-against-the-file-it-is-written-in` and `rule:programs/path-literals-resolve-from-their-file`. Both fragments already state the whole Stage 3 behaviour: the queue half and `script::resolve`'s refusal are written there but not yet built.

`[[schedule]] script` and `[log] handler` (global and `[app.log]`) are joined to the folder of their file while the configuration is read. `nvs_config::schedule::anchor` and `nvs_config::log::anchor` rewrite the typed tree and the table, beside `capability::anchor` in `resolve.rs`. `schedule::validate` checks the anchored value as held. The three `nvs-config` Stage 3 tests are in `crates/nvs-config/tests/resolve.rs`.

`Core\Http\Socket`'s five perf figures were measured again after `socket.rs` changed, and `bun nv proofs --gate` owes nothing.

next.title: scripts start at their file
next.note: one file set, the script resolver and the queue: `crates/nvs-runtime/src/script.rs`, `crates/nvs-runtime/src/capability.rs`, `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/queue.rs`, `crates/nvs-cli/src/worker.rs`, `crates/nvs-host/tests/limits.rs`.

items.text: **`script::resolve` refuses a relative path** (`rule:programs/path-literals-resolve-from-their-file`, ADR 0245 § 3) — ask `capability::relative` before the grant, in `crates/nvs-runtime/src/script.rs:416`, and rewrite the doc at `crates/nvs-runtime/src/capability.rs:134` that names three callers which skip it. Migrate the tests that hand it a relative handler: `crates/nvs-host/tests/limits.rs:779` (its `snapshot_of` at `crates/nvs-host/tests/limits.rs:1209` skips the anchor pass, so name the handler absolute), and check `crates/nvs-cli/tests/live_edit.rs:1` and `crates/nvs-cli/tests/live_config.rs:1231`.

**`Core\Queue::push`'s script is a path parameter** (ADR 0245 § 2) — `CoreTy::Path(Qual::Sink)` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/queue.rs:1914`; a relative path built at run time throws at the push; the row stores the absolute path. Tests: `nvs-types`' `queue_push_script_literal_resolves_from_the_file_that_wrote_it` and `nvs-stdlib`'s `a_pushed_job_stores_an_absolute_script_path` and `a_relative_script_built_at_run_time_throws_at_the_push`. A stored relative row fails at `crates/nvs-cli/src/worker.rs:1379` (ADR 0245 § 4).

**The `nvs-cli` pair** — `a_schedule_script_beside_the_configuration_runs_from_any_working_directory` and `a_log_handler_beside_the_configuration_runs_from_any_working_directory`, which start the server in a working directory that is not the configuration's folder; harness beside `crates/nvs-cli/tests/live_config.rs:1231`.
